title: Human RPE Regional Core
description: Reproducible donor-level analysis of regional transcriptional differences in human retinal pigment epithelium. Frozen analysis scripts, configuration and selected derived tables. Genome-wide external-cohort transferability did not meet the prespecified criterion (Spearman rho = 0.2033; criterion rho >= 0.25). The 71-gene cross-cohort-supported regional core was defined using both cohorts and requires assessment in a third donor-resolved cohort. Gene-activity results provide orthogonal gene-level support, not peak-level or functional validation. This metadata release does not change analyses or numerical results.
